_comment: Example batch manifest. Copy it, rename the assets, and pass it with --manifest. studs = intended longest axis in Roblox studs, sized against a ~5-stud R6 character. Body-shape words are in every prompt on purpose: an early cow came back with horse proportions because nothing told the model otherwise. Optional per-asset keys: tris (triangle budget) and preset (creature or prop).
style: stylized cartoon game character, clean simple shapes, appealing proportions

assets.name: cow
assets.prompt: a cartoon Holstein cow seen from the side, rectangular barrel body, four straight short legs, large friendly head with a broad muzzle, small horns, big black patches on white

assets.name: pig
assets.prompt: a cartoon pink pig seen from the side, round barrel body, four short legs, flat snout, floppy ears, curly tail

assets.name: chicken
assets.prompt: ONE single brown hen alone by itself, exactly one chicken, plump oval body, small red comb, short yellow legs, short rounded tail
